testimonials.content: As a parent, I couldn't be happier with our experience working with Cooch. He is extremely professional, reliable, and flexible with my daughter's busy schedule. He is always willing to give extra time when needed and truly cares about her success. What stands out most is that I never have to convince my daughter to attend her tutoring sessions—she actually asks for them. That says everything. Thank you, Cooch, for making such a positive impact and for being such a dedicated tutor.

testimonials.content: When I started working with Cooch, I had a C in math. After tutoring with him, I quickly raised my grade to an A and have kept an A ever since. Cooch is easy to talk to and makes it comfortable to ask questions or speak up when something doesn’t make sense. My favorite thing about working with him is that he explains problems in multiple ways and keeps going until he finds one that makes sense to me. This has helped me really understand math instead of just memorizing steps and has made me feel more comfortable in my math class.
